title: A Plan and its Reviews read side by side

steps.action: Link two Reviews to a Plan, then open a linked Review.
steps.expected_result: The Plan holds both, and the Review links back to its Plan.

steps.action: Open the comparison of a Plan with a Review that names one Task and has an unrelated slide.
steps.expected_result: The named Task shows the Review slide, the other reads Not delivered, and an unrelated slide is listed as not in the Plan.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
